title: August and the Horizon
author: Emrys Delacroix
blurb: Marguerite Okonkwo, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
